title: Polyrepo Git
rules: Use packet-returned repo and worktree routing.
Never infer branch sets or merge targets from directory names.

sections.heading: Topology
sections.body: Use returned `project.topology`, `track.context`, or `track.worktree_plan` actions. Halt on invalid topology.

sections.heading: Workers
sections.body: Use `parallel.*` actions for setup, finish recording, merge-back, and cleanup. Worker worktrees are siblings of integration worktrees.

sections.heading: Publication
sections.body: Use cadre_workflow for land, ship, revert, archive, and release. Hosted evidence must be returned through the configured provider integration.
